description: Fixed camera and object placements for the single-object VLM dataset (36 positions x 3 shapes x 8 colors). Generated by render_single_object_dataset.py.

image.pixel_coordinates: x right, y down, (0, 0) = top-left image corner; pixel (i, j) covers [i, i+1) x [j, j+1)

grid.row_order: row 0 is the top (farthest) row, col 0 the left column; index = row * 6 + col
grid.projected_center: projection of the object's 3D center (bounding box center) through the camera

object.rotation_note: same yaw for every shape and position; the cube shows one face square-on to the camera

calibration.cost: per mask: #patches with 0 < coverage < fragment_threshold + 0.5 * #patches with fragment_threshold <= coverage < 0.25
